excerpt: Phase 3 operation of the SuperKEKB project began successfully [...] Low-emittance Ampère-level beams were circulated in both rings, but no collisions were possible. [Phase 1, February 2016] [...] the first collisions recorded in the early hours of April 26th [Phase 2, 2018]
